dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, what's wrong? You sound upset.
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, ˈwʌts ˈrɔːŋ? juː ˈsaʊnd ˌʌpˈsɛt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I messed up at work, Nam. I made a really big mistake.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈmɛst ˈʌp ət ˈwɜːrk, ˈnɑːm. aɪ ˈmeɪd ə ˈriːli ˈbɪɡ mɪˈsteɪk.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I ordered T-shirts for our company's sports day. We needed five hundred, but I typed five thousand.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈɔːrdərd ˈtiːʃɜːrts fər aʊr ˈkʌmpəniz ˈspɔːrts ˌdeɪ. wiː ˈniːdɪd ˈfaɪv ˈhʌndrəd, bʌt aɪ ˈtaɪpt ˈfaɪv ˈθaʊzənd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No. If I had noticed the extra zero, I would have fixed it. But it's too late now. They've printed them all.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ. ɪf aɪ hæd ˈnoʊtɪst ði ˈɛkstrə ˈzɪroʊ, aɪ wʊd hæv ˈfɪkst ɪt. bʌt ɪts ˈtuː ˈleɪt ˈnaʊ. ðeɪv ˈprɪntɪd ðɛm ˈɔːl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh, Emma. What did your boss say?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ˈɛmə. ˈwʌt dɪd jʊr ˈbɔːs ˈseɪ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: He was furious. And it's all my fault. I can't blame anyone else.
dialogue.reading: hiː wʌz ˈfjʊriəs. ənd ɪts ˈɔːl maɪ ˈfɔːlt. aɪ ˈkænt ˈbleɪm ˈɛniwʌn ˈɛls.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Don't be so hard on yourself.
dialogue.reading: ˈdoʊnt bi soʊ ˈhɑːrd ɑːn jʊrˈsɛlf.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I really regret it. And the consequences are terrible. The company has to pay for all of them.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈriːli rɪˈɡrɛt ɪt. ənd ðə ˈkɑːnsəkwɛnsɪz ər ˈtɛrəbəl. ðə ˈkʌmpəni ˈhæs tə ˈpeɪ fər ˈɔːl əv ðɛm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: If I had known you were so busy, I would have helped you check it.
dialogue.reading: ɪf aɪ hæd ˈnoʊn juː wɜːr soʊ ˈbɪzi, aɪ wʊd hæv ˈhɛlpt juː ˈtʃɛk ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thanks, Nam. If I had been less tired that day, I would have seen the mistake.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks, ˈnɑːm. ɪf aɪ hæd bɪn ˈlɛs ˈtaɪərd ðæt ˈdeɪ, aɪ wʊd hæv ˈsiːn ðə mɪˈsteɪk.
